t: Designing MCP for LLMs: A Scripted AI Context Approach
s: This article proposes a simpler, script-based approach to providing context for LLM code assistance by listing desired files and framing them with pre/post prompts, contrasting with RAG-indexing tools. It details a specific implementation using Python.
sub: Scripted AI Context Approach for LLMs
Comparison of Context Engineering Methods (RAG vs. Scripted)
Technical Architecture Analysis of Pipulate (Nix, HTMX, Server-State)
Emerging Patterns and Future Evolution for Local-First AI Apps
